properties.name: peach.scheduler.provider
properties.description: Selected SchedulingProvider id. The built-in provider id is quartz.

properties.name: peach.scheduler.application-name
properties.description: Logical application name used by scheduler metadata.

properties.name: peach.scheduler.execution.default-timeout-ms
properties.description: Best-effort execution timeout in milliseconds. Values less than or equal to zero wait indefinitely.

properties.name: peach.scheduler.execution.memory-history-limit
properties.description: Maximum records retained by the development in-memory execution store.

properties.name: peach.scheduler.execution.persist-error-message
properties.description: Persist sanitized exception messages in execution history. Disabled by default to reduce sensitive-data leakage risk.

properties.name: peach.scheduler.store.type
properties.description: Execution history store type. Built-in values are memory and jdbc.
